detail.zh-CN: 较长的成片拖动进度条、逐帧、跳到首尾，不再回到第一帧。
detail.en: Dragging the timeline, stepping frames and jumping to the start or end no longer snap back to the first frame in longer videos.

detail.zh-CN: 播放中点播放键就能暂停，不必再点画面。
detail.en: Clicking the play button during playback pauses it; no need to click the picture.

detail.zh-CN: 作业结束通知改用开关；路径框的提示文字和其他输入框字体一致。
detail.en: Job-finished notifications use a switch, and path fields show their hint in the same font as other fields.
